spell.elyrium.reverse_sunder.name: Reverse Sunder

spell.elyrium.piercing_thrust.descriptio: 5.5m linear thrust completely bypassing armor: deals {damage} true damage.

spell.elyrium.scissor_cross.description: Cross cleave with dual blades: deals {damage} damage across two strikes and inflicts Deep Wounds.
spell.elyrium.iai_slash.name: Phantom Iai Slash
spell.elyrium.iai_slash.description: Instant 6m forward dash through enemies: deals {damage} damage and causes heavy Bleeding.
spell.elyrium.fan_barrage.name: Fan Barrage
